audit.whatIsWrong: Both charts read Lucian/Lucian/Lucian/Skill/Lucian/Skill/Lucian, which is the generic template pattern, not this lane. The content whys directly under them read Lucian / Skill / Darius / Darius / Darius / Darius / Darius, and the packet levelChart says the same.
audit.why: Lucian owns Level 1 (Piercing Light plus a Lightslinger double-shot before Apprehend exists) and Level 2 is genuinely a standoff, but from Level 3 Apprehend's 535 range is longer than Piercing Light's 500 and he never gains a defensive tool — 52.87% over 5,814 games is a Darius lane after the first two levels.
audit.corrected: Chart set to Lucian, Skill, Darius, Darius, Darius, Darius, Darius, proposed as one atomic group across both layers, with ratings moved onto the matching scale and phases[0].why rewritten so the Level 1 text stops claiming Darius wins it.

audit.whatIsWrong: spikes[1] (Lvl 6) says 'Lucian's R Culling is a channel with no mobility, so once you're on top of him he can't use it to escape'. Nothing in Riot's text supports the no-mobility claim — The Culling carries no channel flag in the kit, only projectile.
audit.why: The Culling is 110/100/90s at 1400 range and is a damage tool, not an escape. What he actually leaves fights with is Relentless Pursuit. Building the Level 6 spike on an unverified immobility claim puts the reader's all-in on a fact I cannot check.
audit.corrected: spikes[1] rewritten around the two things that are verifiable — The Culling's 110s cost and that Relentless Pursuit is the real exit — so the advice (bait the dash, then execute) survives either way.

audit.whatIsWrong: The single most important line in Lucian's kit for this matchup was never mentioned: 'Lightslinger attacks reduce Relentless Pursuit's cooldown.' The page instead says only 'His dash + reset. Engage when it's down.'
audit.why: That turns 'wait for his dash' from a passive timer into something you control — every Lightslinger double-shot he lands on you or the wave shortens his 16s escape. Denying his autos IS denying his exit, which is the whole reason a Darius freeze works here.
audit.corrected: winCon, breakdown.cooldowns, dosFull[0] and content spikes[0]/mid all now key the engage to keeping Lightslinger attacks off you rather than to a fixed timer.

audit.whatIsWrong: Piercing Light's actual range (500) is never given, and the page claims he 'out-ranges' you — while Apprehend is 535. It also never mentions that Piercing Light fires THROUGH a target, or that Ardent Blaze is what supplies his kiting move speed.
audit.why: Riot: Piercing Light 'shoots a bolt of piercing light through a target', 500 range. So a Q aimed directly at you is cast from inside Apprehend's 535 — a free grab. To poke safely he must fire through a minion. Ardent Blaze (900 range, 14s at rank 1) 'marks' you and 'Lucian gains Move Speed for attacking marked enemies' — the mark, not the dash, is his kite engine.
audit.corrected: tldr, enemyWin, content early and wants.foe[0] rebuilt around the 500-vs-535 range fact and the Ardent Blaze mark.

audit.whatIsWrong: The Jungle Interaction line only covers you ganking him. It omits that a gank on YOU is worth extra damage to Lucian specifically.
audit.why: Lightslinger: 'when a nearby enemy Champion is immobilized, his next 2 basic attacks will deal bonus magic damage.' Any hard CC his jungler lands on you empowers two Lucian autos on top of the gank itself.
audit.corrected: report[10].t now states the empowerment so the reader prices a gank correctly.

edits.before: He kites your pull — freeze near tower and E-pull the step-up, then run him down.

edits.after: Freeze, pull his misstep, and execute at 5 stacks. Every Lightslinger attack he lands shortens Relentless Pursuit, so deny the autos.

edits.before: Lucian wins by landing Relentless Pursuit, denying your pattern, and kiting you off the wave.
edits.after: Lucian wins by Q-ing through minions, marking you with Ardent Blaze for speed, and kiting you off.

edits.before: Your AA + W chop wins most level-1 exchanges, and every auto starts the Hemorrhage clock. Trade on his last-hits but don't chase past the wave.
edits.after: Level 1 is his: Piercing Light plus a Lightslinger double-shot out-damages your walk-up before Apprehend exists. Farm and eat the chip.

edits.before: E (Apprehend) is live — your kill threat starts here. Hold it for a guaranteed pull; a whiffed Apprehend is a free lane for Lucian.
edits.after: Apprehend is live at 535 — your kill threat starts here. Hold it for a certain pull; a whiff is 26 seconds of free lane for Lucian.

edits.before: You stay a side-lane terror but fall off vs grouped teams. Look for flank pulls in fights; one reset chain can win the game.
edits.after: Lucian never gets tankier — one Apprehend at 535 still ends him. Flank for pulls; a Guillotine reset chain wins the fight.

edits.before: - Lucian Relentless Pursuit: matchup-defining — His dash + reset. Engage when it's down. Track it before every engage. - Your engage/committal tool: never waste it on chip damage. - Your ultimate: the win condition — spend it on kill windows, not on waves.
edits.after: - Relentless Pursuit: 16s at rank 1, but every Lightslinger attack he lands cuts it — deny his autos and the dash stays down. - Ardent Blaze: 14s at rank 1; the mark is what feeds his move speed. - Piercing Light: 9s at rank 1. - Apprehend: 26s at rank 1, so whiff nothing.

edits.before: Track Lucian's Relentless Pursuit before you commit
edits.after: Deny his autos — they shorten Relentless Pursuit

edits.before: His dash + reset. Engage when it's down. Only engage once it is down or baited.
edits.after: Lightslinger attacks cut its 16s cooldown, so every landed auto buys him an exit.

edits.before: Your engage is premium gank setup — ping your jungler when Relentless Pursuit is down. Ward river before extended trades; you are most gankable mid-combo.
edits.after: Ping your jungler when Relentless Pursuit is down. The reverse hurts: his jungler's CC on you empowers Lucian's next two attacks, so ganks land harder than they look.

edits.before: Lucian owns level 1-2: his Q Piercing Light and Lightslinger passive out-range and out-poke you before you have E, and his E dash lets him weave in and out of your Q Decimate freely, so respect the poke and just farm.
edits.after: Lucian owns level 1: Piercing Light fires through a minion, so he pokes from behind the wave while a Lightslinger double-shot follows every cast. At 2 it evens out — your AA plus Crippling Strike answers, so respect the poke and farm.

edits.before: By level 3 you flip it hard — the whole matchup hinges on landing E Apprehend on his dash; once you do, W Crippling Strike plus a full Hemorrhage rotation shreds his low health pool and he has no defensive tool left.
edits.after: By level 3 you flip it hard — the matchup hinges on landing Apprehend while Relentless Pursuit sits on its 16s; the pull into W Crippling Strike and a full Hemorrhage rotation shreds his health pool with nothing left to leave on.

edits.before: Once you have E Apprehend you turn the lane: bait his Lightslinger double-shot and E-pull him as he tries to dash away with E Relentless Pursuit, then W Crippling Strike and rotate Q for a huge Hemorrhage bleed he can't run from.
edits.after: Once you have E Apprehend you turn the lane: pull only after Relentless Pursuit is spent, since its 16s shortens every time his Lightslinger attacks land, then W Crippling Strike and rotate Q for a bleed he can't run from.

edits.before: Lucian's R Culling is a channel with no mobility, so once you're on top of him he can't use it to escape; a five-stack Hemorrhage R Noxian Guillotine executes him well before his squishy frame can kite back to safety.
edits.after: The Culling is a 110s damage ultimate, not an exit — the tool he actually leaves with is Relentless Pursuit. Bait that dash first, then a five-stack Noxian Guillotine executes him in true damage no resist of his touches.

edits.before: Level 1 belongs to Lucian's superior Lightslinger poke and dash mobility.
edits.after: Level 1 belongs to Lucian: Piercing Light through a minion, then a double-shot.

edits.before: Poke with Lightslinger passive from max range
edits.after: Poke with Piercing Light through a minion

notes: The _missing file lists this matchup under rule needs-antiheal for Lightslinger, but Riot's text only says Lucian is empowered 'when Lucian is healed or shielded by an ally' — he has no self-heal anywhere in the kit, so that is a derived-flag misfire and no Grievous Wounds advice was written.
